preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 1 and 100000.
The number of edges m must be between 0 and the minimum of n(n-1)/2 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n and 1 <= b_i <= n and a_i != b_i for a_i, b_i in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect two distinct vertices within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output must be the weight of the minimum spanning tree of the graph.
